by: converted (convert1d) from fact_check__1.json and the research's 3 searches

checks.claim: Home microwave ovens use waves at 2.45 gigahertz, about 2.45 billion cycles a second
checks.why: EMF Portal and IEEE both give 2.45 GHz for home ovens.

checks.claim: Microwaves penetrate only about 1 to 1.5 inches into food; deeper parts are cooked by heat conduction
checks.why: The USDA FSIS fact sheet says exactly this.

sources.title: Microwave Ovens and Food Safety (USDA FSIS)

checks.claim: The metal mesh in a microwave door has holes much smaller than the 12 centimetre wavelength, so the waves cannot pass
checks.why: The Straight Dope gives a 12 cm wavelength and 1 to 2 mm holes.

sources.title: What keeps microwave radiation from leaking out the oven door?
